rules_must_remain: Q116: current-equity single 0.5% and combined 1.0% estimated pre-order risk, existing positions plus pending orders plus candidate.
Q117: external-cashflow-adjusted change since NY17:00 opening equity, crosschecked against PnL and charges.
Q118: daily limit equals opening equity x 1.5%, fixed throughout day including deposits and profits.
Q119: unitized drawdown adjusted for external flows, DD4/DD5 human-gated stop reasons never clear on numeric rebound.
Q121: independent stop latches; unknown data and unresolved order outcomes fail closed.
Q128: 15 seconds is explicitly for DD2/3 monitoring-release inputs, not a blanket market-quote/account valuation TTL.

required: Account, currency, current equity and broker source
observation and receipt timestamps
causal ordering relative to positions, orders, price and margin state
data complete and verified
checks.reason: No generic approved pre-order equity maximum age.

checks.event: Pre-order exposure or any retry review
required: All matching account positions with IDs/side/volume and server SL
snapshot provenance, partial fills and independent broker history
absence of unobserved concurrent intervention must be established
checks.reason: Coherent order/position epoch needs broker-specific validation, not a universal value.

required: Broker-side pending list
local PREPARED/DISPATCHING and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN intents
order/fill overlap and reservations reconciled
checks.reason: Unknown dispatch effects must not be counted as zero risk.

required: Bid/ask, symbol contract and price origin
all exchange conversion legs and their timestamps
quote/account-currency coherence and spread/cost assumptions
checks.reason: Price freshness thresholds depend on broker market, symbol and execution mode and are unapproved.

required: Trading day identifier in America/New_York and DST
immutable opening-equity snapshot for the trading day
provenance, timestamp, durability, startup/backfill integrity
checks.reason: Daily opening value is a fixed session anchor; not a rolling 15-second quote.

required: External/internals classification
effective timestamp, corrections and settlement status
complete account ledger with signed amounts and causal ordering
checks.reason: Late flows and posting changes require reconciliation, not a generic time-to-live.

checks.event: Independent check of daily net-equity delta
required: Realized/unrealized PnL, commissions, swaps and fees
no double count, complete time window and matching account
discrepancy provenance and corrective history
checks.reason: Tolerance and booking latency remain unapproved.

required: Continuous unit balances and cashflow-priced issuance/redemption records
unit value, high-water and chronological valuations
replay-safe restore and source history completeness
checks.reason: No generic valuation freshness adopted for all DD computations.

required: DD observation freshness <= 15 seconds per Q128
Q129 origin/receipt timestamps
Q124/125 strict threshold and continuous valid 30-minute samples
Q130-Q147 clock validity and subsequent watchdog restrictions
checks.reason: Specific adopted DD2/3 monitoring-release bound; not a universal pricing/entry data default.

checks.event: Restart or loss of data continuity
required: Independent durable stop reasons with generation/ordering and failure detection
clock continuity and Q147 monotonic elapsed-time evidence where applicable
account/position/order reconciliation before any stop-specific clearance
checks.reason: Incomplete or unknown stop state denies new orders regardless of numeric timestamps.

numerical_examples.explanation: Pure arithmetic using assumed losses and account values. These are NOT broker SL calculations, adopted conversion/rounding or actual order permissions.

unitized_drawdown.assumption: Illustration only: initial virtual unit quantity=1000, initial unit value and HWM=100 JPY; issue new units at illustrative pre-flow unit price of 96, no rounding/costs.
unitized_drawdown.caution: The unit issuance/high-water details remain unapproved; the arithmetic is a demonstration of avoiding cashflow-induced false DD recovery.

monitor_thresholds.meaning: At equality, strict release candidate not reached; 30-minute and safety conditions remain necessary even if below.
Below-threshold candidate only, not automatic immediate release.
At equality, strict release candidate not reached.
Below-threshold candidate only; Q125 continuity remains necessary.

unresolved: Actual market-data freshness ceilings for all non-DD-monitor-release domains remain unset; do not invent 15-second universal default.
Q116 cost/slippage/JPY conversions, lot rounding, position-and-pending snapshot concurrency and conflicting observations need formula and broker-specific verification.
Daily external-flow classification and exact corrections, profit offset, missing NY17 snapshots, weekend/holiday handling, fee double count and tolerance require user-approved detail.
Unit issue/redeem conventions, HWM restoration, zero/negative equity handling, precision and flow timestamp order require validated formal formula.
A mathematical result at/below limits is not authorization to order; independently reconcile broker state, Q121 latches, AI checks, event windows, approvals and PHASE-1 gate.
